# SocialForex
**Forex tools, signals, journal and community for traders — open source.**
### 👉 Try it live: **toolforex.xyz**
Tiếng Việt · Features · Self-hosting · Sponsor
SocialForex is a full-stack trading companion for retail forex / gold / crypto traders. It combines
live market data, a community signal room, MT5 copy-trading, a deep trading journal with AI reviews,
and an academy for beginners — in Vietnamese and English.
> ⚠️ Everything in this project is for education and information only. It is **not investment advice
**. Trading leveraged products carries a high risk of losing money.

- **Next.js 16** (App Router) + **React 19**, **Tailwind CSS v4** + shadcn/ui

reSQL
